candidates.mechanism: Label each day low/medium/high volatility by ranking 20-day realised vol against its own trailing 252-day 33rd/67th percentiles, estimate the 3x3 regime transition matrix by counting, and trade a base rule (5/9 MA crossover with 4% TP / 2% SL in the donor) only in the low-vol regime. The donor's point is the CONTROL: the filtered rule's return is mostly market beta, so the regime filter must be judged against exposure, not against zero.
candidates.title: US500 regime_split (QG26-05)
candidates.failure_mode_hypothesis: partition_return timing share <= 0 or monkey beat-rate < 0.9 on the gated cell.

candidates.mechanism: Hold a long core; every 63 trading days set a downside floor 10% below and an upside give-up 28% above the reset price (a zero-cost collar in the donor). When a reset period closes 5% or more down, the floor's payoff is redeployed into more of the core at the depressed price; rallies above the cap are funded by trimming. The 'good volatility drag' claim: buying the fire sale with hedge proceeds turns a drawdown into extra exposure at a low basis.
candidates.title: US500 drawdown_conditional (QG26-16)
candidates.failure_mode_hypothesis: Timing share <= 0 or monkey beat-rate < 0.9.
